resources.string: A private, offline keyboard for Tamil, English and Tanglish.

Tanglish Pro has no Internet permission and includes no analytics. Translation runs on this device. Clipboard history and shortcuts are stored locally on your phone. Clipboard entries are saved only when you open Clipboard from the keyboard.
Open any app, tap a text field, then use the keyboard mode buttons. Tap Translate to convert the current Tanglish text.
